rubric.role_summary: Experienced mobile-game producer for an R&D team working on puzzle and casual games. The role oversees a product-development area, researches the market, analyzes product metrics, and develops and executes a product roadmap.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Experienced mobile-game producer for an R&D team working on puzzle and casual games. The role oversees a product-development area, researches the market, analyzes product metrics, and develops and executes a product roadmap.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience in mobile game development as a Senior/Lead Game Designer or a Producer/Product Manager.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience developing casual or puzzle games.
- Knowledge of mobile-game trends and features.
- Knowledge of game/product design.
- Ability to analyze the market.
- Knowledge of monetization trends.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Poland. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
